data_sources.admission_status: PASS_WITH_SCOPE_LIMITS: M02/M03 accepted canonical data; selected data pages audited, not every historical row decoded; not a full-market or financial-validity claim
source_evidence: Existing project: A股市场行为自动发现与概率统计研究系统_PRD_v1.0_20260925/reports/M02分钟序列标准化验收报告.md, lines 3-50.
Existing project: reports/M03行为切片验收报告.md, lines 3-69; M03 accepted 5,630 date outputs with scope limits.
Existing project DATA_PROFILE.csv identifies raw_stock_minute at this path, frequency 1min, fields open,high,low,close,amount,volume.
M02 scanned 5,630 existing archive dates and produced 3,602,865,840 canonical rows / 15,011,941 security-days; 1,458,212 active security-days had no archive member.

M02 isolated source member problems including 475,299 schema-mismatch members across 177 dates, 11,052 duplicate normalized BJ members, 3,145 OHLC-invalid members, 46 wrong-row-count members, 4 parse errors and 1 non-CSV member.

M02 independent data-page QA sampled 31 dates (21,583,200 rows); it did not independently re-read every historical data page. M03 validated all 5,630 date manifests/footers but fully decoded event data pages for 12 selected dates; 178 canonical date partitions are empty.
Archive inventory: 5,630 of 5,632 calendar dates; missing 2005-06-15 and 2013-11-13.
2026-09-01 inventory: 5,988 members, 1,437,120 rows, 240 rows/member; 5,553 active Qlib stock-master codes present and 435 extra members excluded.
Time labels are derived from archive date and row index; row-end mapping is sample-supported. Raw files have no timestamp column and no true receive/available-at timestamp.
2026-09-01 includes 219 bars with volume=0 and amount>0; preserve but mark volume untrusted.
notes: Price data are raw/unadjusted intraday; do not compute cross-day returns without an explicitly validated adjustment/return protocol.

M02/M03 are PASS_WITH_SCOPE_LIMITS. M02 scanned all archive dates/members and built canonical output, but independent data-page QA was sampled; M03 output closure passed while 178 canonical date partitions remain empty and data-page decoding covered 12 selected dates.
Some schema, duplicate, OHLC, row-count and parse-error members were isolated; do not interpret missing or isolated security-days as observed data.
Historical raw archives do not contain receive-time/available-at. Replay must explicitly specify availability and latency; never substitute event time silently.
Daily moneyflow is not admitted and L2 archives are deferred in the source project; neither is included by this mapping.

processing_provenance.interpretation: These hashes identify existing processing QA artifacts and runner/config versions; they are not a cryptographic hash of the raw source archives.

unresolved_blockers: 分钟候选源已映射，但本轮 required_frequencies 仍为空；尚未确定具体任务类型和频率，也未核定 source_version、calendar_version、universe_version 与 raw_snapshot_hash。
原始分钟归档没有真实 receive_time/available_at 字段，修订时间也未记录；需冻结回放可用时点规则和延迟假设，不能把事件时点等同于可用时点。
尚未冻结标签、入场/退出时点、时间切分、purge/embargo 和外层盲测权限。
尚未核实本轮交易验证所需的 A 股历史涨跌幅规则、交易费用、滑点、冲击、容量及 T+1 卖出限制。
尚未验证研究反馈是否彻底隔离最终测试集。
日频资金流的本地来源血缘及 .BJ 覆盖仍未核实；L2 逐笔数据不属于当前已映射的准入输入。
policy: 本文件是无样例数据的契约模板，不代表任何数据源已接入或字段已验证。正式实验前必须通过 python3 scripts/validate_quant_contract.py --strict。
